note: Original JSON values, prompts, schemas and embedded rule source; not rewritten rules.

contract.input: Final Round4 image/case reports only; no raw-report recovery or R2-card labels.
contract.scope: Direct clinical fields only. All extra_attributes, source_laterality, entity bookkeeping and evidence are excluded.
contract.labels: Categorical tags only, no arbitrary ordinal scores or probabilities.
contract.single: At most one assigned tag in a group. Specific overlapping cues and explicit declared refinements resolve redundant general tags; distinct incompatible cues remain ambiguous.
contract.multiple: Independent tags may coexist; a generic tag covered by a more specific cue is suppressed.
contract.missing: none/unknown/missing produces no clinical label, never an implicit normal/negative.
contract.negation: Explicit negative findings are distinct from missing. Negated positive matches are not emitted.
contract.uncertainty: Uncertain wording is ambiguous unless the tag explicitly encodes uncertainty.
contract.anatomic_region: Stable benchmark IDs anatomic_region.laterality/anatomy read independent filtered laterality/anatomy fields, NEVER combined anatomic_region.
contract.case: Regions follow the Round4 exact merge; Instances retain each image observation without further collapse.
contract.references: Vocabulary/matchers adapted from main_code/r4-benchmark_building v3-5.2; no new diagnostic criteria or disease inference.
contract.decision_unit: one entity observation / one direct attribute / one benchmark group; never the union of all entities in an image or case
contract.position_cardinality: Both independent source fields are scalar per entity; a rejected part does not remove the other part.
contract.missing_policy: none/unknown/rejected are unlabelled; isthmus has no left/right laterality.
contract.ambiguity_policy: uncertainty, unsupported position scalars and incompatible single-group cues have no valid target labels
contract.aggregation_policy: image/case coverage may be multi-valued across distinct entities but does not change per-entity group cardinality
contract.scope_policy: only explicitly supported overall-entity cues enter an overall echo-level group; local areas, halos and mural components do not
contract.tag_definition_policy: tag meanings are dataset text categories; no diagnosis, TIRADS category or measurement value is inferred
